rules: Require the exact IA commdrza00ursi identity and all eight pinned retained-envelope member hashes.

Require the candidate primary-source authority set to equal the five retained_files bound by the acquisition sidecar; bind receipt, metadata, inventory, and reconstruction dependencies as support authorities.
Independently account for all 720 PDF/OCR pages, 722 scandata leaves, two explicitly excluded color cards, 16 empty OCR pages, all ordered paragraphs and lines, and 436 source-derived contents rows.
Require one TEI root, one text element, and one body division for the single source-titled commentary represented by duplicate manifest rows L427 and L468.

Independently transcribe and verify scan-layout structures on leaves 205, 489, 529, 552, 578, 613, and 639, including the comparison-table column headings and thirteen row pairings on leaf 489; bind each graph node to its exact OCR paragraph carriers and retained scan figure.

Reconcile every TEI page, line, paragraph, contents row, and source-layout link to independent source-derived expectations; verify every external facsimile URI resolves to the retained scan.pdf bytes.
Validate the TEI against the bound TEI P5 XSD and Relax NG schemas and source-accountability against its bound JSON Schema.

Preserve OCR readings and bind the comprehensive OCR-to-scan collation gap; do not infer missing text or convert technical validation into human acceptance, rights clearance, or publication authorization.
Require current declared work, state snapshot, edition, and acquisition sidecars to bind the candidate; reproduce the sealed package and validation from fresh processes.

unresolved_fidelity_gaps.statement: Provider OCR spelling and transcription have not been comprehensively proofread against every retained scan page. Preserve OCR readings without silent correction.
unresolved_fidelity_gaps.disposition: Candidate preserves the retained OCR witness and page/paragraph/line order; comprehensive glyph-level scan collation remains open.
